description: This file defines the 'component' class which functions as a connector component in the SuiteCRM environment. It includes methods for initializing, filling beans with data, saving configurations, and mapping data between external sources and SugarCRM Beans. It also manages source configuration and field definitions, and interacts with external filter factories.

classes.name: component
classes.description: A connector class for integrating external data sources with SuiteCRM, providing methods to retrieve, map, and save data, as well as handle configurations and source interactions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method for the component class.

methods.name: fillBean
methods.description: Fetches an item from the external source based on arguments and loads the data into a SugarBean object, applying mapping rules.

methods.name: fillBeans
methods.description: Fetches a list of items and populates multiple SugarBean instances with data, applying mappings and handling options.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists a given SugarBean to the external data source.

methods.name: getFieldDefs
methods.description: Retrieves field definitions from the source.

methods.name: mapInput
methods.description: Transforms input data based on mapping rules, supporting nested field evaluation.

methods.name: mapOutput
methods.description: Maps external data results onto a SugarBean based on configured mappings.

methods.name: getFieldValue
methods.description: Retrieves and optionally transforms a field value from the result data for a given bean.

methods.name: setMapping
methods.description: Sets the data mapping configuration on the source.

methods.name: getMapping
methods.description: Retrieves the current data mapping configuration.

methods.name: getModuleMapping
methods.description: Gets the field mapping for a specific module.

methods.name: getModuleFieldDef
methods.description: Retrieves the field definition for a specific module and field, considering mapping and definitions.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the current data source object.

methods.name: setSource
methods.description: Assigns a data source object to this connector.
